needed.evidence: The left side of the road is bounded by a low wall and a grassy verge, with no paved or designated path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway along the left side of the road, separated from the carriageway by a kerb.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is separated from the adjacent buildings by a high concrete barrier, providing no access for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Provide a safe and accessible footway on the right side, either by lowering the barrier or building a new path.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the mixed-use buildings on both sides, but no marked or signalised crossing is visible in the 100m stretch.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to allow safe passage across the multi-lane road.

needed.evidence: The road has four or more lanes, and any future crossing would be difficult to cross in one go without a refuge.
needed.suggestion: Ensure that any new pedestrian crossing includes a central refuge island to allow users to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
